title: docs: add troubleshooting runbook sorted by monitor symptom
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
@@ -116,3 +116,27 @@ curl -sI https://status.philipp-klinger.com/dashboard | head -1
 
 - Kuma runs on the same VPS it watches: if the whole server is down, no alert goes out. An external check is planned for later.
 - The public heartbeat API of Kuma 2 returns the 24-hour uptime only; the 30-day value is available as a badge.
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+Commands run in `/srv/monitoring`. Problems of the proxy itself are in the runbook of [vps-edge](https://github.com/PhilippKlinger/vps-edge#troubleshooting).
+
+### Status page down
+
+**Symptom:** the status page returns 404 or 502, the monitored sites work.
+
+**Check:** `docker compose ps` shows whether `uptime-kuma` is healthy; `docker network inspect monitoring --format '{{range .Containers}}{{.Name}} {{end}}'` must list Caddy and Kuma. A 404 on a path that should be public points to the allowlist in `sites/status.caddy` of vps-edge.
+
+**Fix:** Kuma not healthy → `docker compose logs --tail 50 uptime-kuma`, then `docker compose up -d`. Network missing → start or update vps-edge first, then `docker compose up -d` here.
+
+**Way back:** revert the image update or the allowlist change through a pull request.
+
+### All monitors red
+
+**Symptom:** all monitors report down at the same moment, but the sites open from outside.
+
+**Check:** Kuma reaches nothing outside: `docker compose exec uptime-kuma getent hosts github.com` fails, or the network `outbound` is missing in `docker compose ps --format '{{.Networks}}'`. On the host, `resolvectl status` shows whether DNS works.
+
+**Fix:** `docker compose up -d --force-recreate` attaches the networks again; a DNS problem of the host is fixed on the host. No change in this repository causes this case, so there is nothing to roll back.
+
+**Way back:** none needed.

title: ci: accept bundled Kuma vulnerabilities with reason and expiry
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -146,10 +146,13 @@ jobs:
 
       # Official Trivy image pinned by digest instead of a third-party action.
       # Reports HIGH and CRITICAL, fails on critical findings that already have a fix.
+      # Accepted risks with reason and expiry date: .trivyignore.yaml
       - name: Scan image with Trivy
         run: |
           set -Eeuo pipefail
           image="$(sed -n 's/^ *image: *//p' compose.yaml)"
           echo "Image: ${image}"
           docker run --rm "${TRIVY_IMAGE}" image --no-progress --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed "${image}"

+            image --no-progress --quiet --severity CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed \
+            --ignorefile /trivyignore.yaml --exit-code 1 "${image}"
diff --git a/.trivyignore.yaml b/.trivyignore.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@

title: ci: validate, smoke test and scan the monitoring stack
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+# Actions are pinned by commit SHA; the comment shows the readable version.
+# Validates the stack, starts it for real and scans the pinned image.
+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+  # Scheduled runs catch image vulnerabilities published after the last push.
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "17 4 * * 1"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+env:
+  TRIVY_IMAGE: aquasec/trivy:0.76.1@sha256:790fd66d1697395d8693d1acaa1ea702406a20f109b6fc7bac8db623eca6c06c
+  ACTIONLINT_IMAGE: rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12@sha256:b1934ee5f1c509618f2508e6eb47ee0d3520686341fec936f3b79331f9315667
+
+jobs:
+  validate:
+    name: Validate compose and workflows
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      # On the server vps-edge creates this network; here it is a stand-in.
+      - name: Create external network
+        run: docker network create --internal monitoring
+
+      - name: Validate compose.yaml
+        run: docker compose config --quiet
+
+      - name: Lint workflows (actionlint)
+        run: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/repo" -w /repo "${ACTIONLINT_IMAGE}" -color
+
+  smoke-test:
+    name: Start stack and check security properties

+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Start stack

title: feat: add Uptime Kuma stack behind the edge proxy
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/.github/dependabot.yml b/.github/dependabot.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+version: 2
+updates:
+  # Uptime Kuma image in compose.yaml
+  - package-ecosystem: "docker-compose"
+    directory: "/"
+    schedule:
+      interval: "weekly"
+    # Wait 14 days before proposing a new release; security updates are not delayed.
+    cooldown:
+      default-days: 14
+    commit-message:
+      prefix: "chore(deps)"
+
+  # Pinned action SHAs in .github/workflows
+  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
+    directory: "/"
+    schedule:
+      interval: "weekly"
+    cooldown:
+      default-days: 14
+    commit-message:
+      prefix: "ci(deps)"
diff --git a/compose.yaml b/compose.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Monitoring stack: Uptime Kuma checks the public HTTPS addresses and serves the public status page.
+# Caddy (vps-edge) reaches it over the network "monitoring"; no project container is reachable from here.
+name: monitoring
+
+services:
+  uptime-kuma:
+    # slim: SQLite only, no embedded MariaDB or Chromium; rootless: runs as user "node"
+    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2.5.9-slim-rootless@sha256:053a48927ee714b1da78c6810041a44a266bd8c06dc30ead5b3f459d0f219fb0
+    environment:
+      # Skips the database setup page on the first start; SQLite lives in the volume below
+      UPTIME_KUMA_DB_TYPE: sqlite
+    volumes:
+      # SQLite database: monitors, status pages, notifications and the uptime history
+      - kuma_data:/app/data
+    ports:
+      # Dashboard only through an SSH tunnel. Never bind to 0.0.0.0: Docker bypasses ufw
+      - "127.0.0.1:3001:3001"
+    # The image brings its own healthcheck (extra/healthcheck)
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    mem_limit: 512m
+    cpus: 1
+    pids_limit: 256
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    # Same as the other stacks: journald deletes logs after 14 days (vps-edge host/journald-retention.conf)
+    logging:
+      driver: journald
+    networks: [monitoring, outbound]
